target_description: Percentage correction for subhourly resolution effects. Positive = hourly overestimates, negative = hourly underestimates.

feature_sources.latitude: from input CSV or site metadata
feature_sources.longitude: from input CSV or site metadata
feature_sources.cf_60min: from hourly PySAM simulation capacity factor
feature_sources.climate_cloudy: one-hot encoded from climate_type classification (derived from weather data)
feature_sources.climate_variable: one-hot encoded from climate_type classification (derived from weather data)

notes: Trained on NSRDB 5-min vs 60-min paired PySAM simulations. Captures satellite-observable portion of subhourly resolution effect. Ground-truth 1-min data would show larger corrections.
